draft.title: Migrate to PostgreSQL 16 — v4
sections: Summary: Zero-downtime upgrade from PG14 to PG16 with automated rollback and full observability.
Impact: No user-facing downtime. Read replicas serve during cutover. Write buffers hold up to 60 s of traffic.
Migration Plan: Deploy PG16 standby → sync via logical replication → validate checksums → promote → redirect via load balancer.
Rollback Plan: Load balancer flips to old PG14 primary. Logical replication slot allows replay.
Risk Assessment: Low — tested in staging three times. Monitoring dashboards validated for lag and replication status.
